newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanxi Nanfeng plans to offer 70 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanxi Nanfeng plans to offer 70 mln A shares.

text.p: Shanxi Nanfeng Co Ltd plans to soon apply to the China Securities Regulatory Commission to launch an initial public offering of 70 million A shares, an official involved in the issue said on Monday.

Nanfeng, based in the city of Yuncheng in Shanxi province, chiefly makes raw materials for detergent powder, an official at China Southern Securities, the offer's lead underwriter, told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The offer, which will be launched in April 1997 if approval is gained, has been tentatively priced at 5.50 yuan per share, the official said.
Nanfeng has not yet decided whether to list the A shares in Shenzhen or Shanghai, he said.
If successful, Nanfeng plans to channel the proceeds into its core operations, the official said.
He said Nanfeng forecast net profits of about 80 million yuan for 1996, compared with 50 million yuan in 1995 and 40 million yuan a year earlier. The figures are not audited, he added.
